messages:
matt_prod: FYI we received a DSAR from an EU customer asking for full export + permanent deletion of their data (includes chat history, embeddings, and related snapshots). They also cc'd their outside counsel and asked to preserve evidence until counsel confirms.
lia_legal: Acknowledged. I'll confirm with counsel whether they want a legal hold. Until then treat as preservation request. We must respond within 72 hours with substantive acknowledgment.
tasha_ops: Which infra is this on (hosted/dedicated)? Need to know key ownership and snapshot locations before any deletion.
matt_prod: Hosted tenant. Embeddings encrypted with tenant DEK wrapped by our eu KMS key (arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:987654:key/ef01). Backups are replicated across eu-west and us-east buckets. One older snapshot is in S3 Glacier.
omar_kms: Important: do NOT schedule key deletion or rewrap during the DSAR. We can rotate keys but must ensure previous data can still be decrypted for the export.
samir_sec: Also note the DSAR message mentions a low-severity vuln they reported. We must scrub internal remediation notes from any export. Security should perform redaction and provide a sanitized export.
lia_legal: Good point. Export must be customer-facing only. Legal will want chain-of-custody logs showing any holds and retention-exception approvals.
tasha_ops: I'll run a read-only inventory: `./tools/emb-list --tenant cust-eu-778 --format json --dry-run` and `aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket redwood-backups --prefix cust-eu-778/`. Posting results to private evidence channel.
matt_prod: Do we have object-lock or legal-hold tags on any of the backup objects? That changes deletion flow.
tasha_ops: Quick check shows: object-lock: false on latest. Old snapshot 2023-09-14 is in glacier and has no object-lock. Replicas exist in us-east bucket with versioning enabled.
omar_kms: For RBAC: legal needs read access to exports and audit proofs. We should create a short-lived role with assume-role TTL 8h, MFA required, and scope to s3:GetObject for export-bucket + logs:Read. Do not grant kms:Decrypt by default. If decrypt needed, require a gated approval (dual-approver).
samir_sec: We can use the incident-access flow: create a timeboxed role and require an approval ticket in PagerDuty + audit annotation. That gives us an auditable trail.
dsar-bot: DSAR intake created: DSAR-2024-599. Status: ACKED_BY_LEGAL. Assigned: lia_legal. Evidence channel created `#evidence-dsar-599`.
lia_legal: Action for legal: confirm counsel wants hold or not. If they want hold, file a retention-exception ticket and tag the tenant as `hold:legal` to block automatic TTL cleanup.
tasha_ops: Action for ops: enumerate all copies (buckets, snapshots, replicas), list lifecycle policies, and check Glacier restore timeline if deletion required. ETA 3h for inventory, 12-24h if restore required.
omar_kms: Action for KMS: add metadata flag `no-delete` and ensure key policy prevents self-service deletion. We'll also record key provenance and publish a kms:DescribeKey snapshot to evidence.
samir_sec: Action for security: prepare redaction rules and generate a sanitized export template. Exclude internal channels/attachments and any incident remediation notes. We'll also sign a hash of the original audit logs and include the signed digest in the evidence package.
lia_legal: If counsel does NOT request hold, proceed with deletion workflow after confirming all copies removed and backups expired. Liaison will confirm deletion timeline per GDPR (one month unless extended).
matt_prod: Note: do not perform bulk deletes via SQL or direct DB migrants without approval. Use ops delete job that logs each object deletion and produces a manifest.	asha_ops: We'll produce a deletion manifest with per-object checksums and store it in the evidence channel. Manifest includes S3 object versions and KMS key ids used.
samir_sec: For the vuln claim: open a separate vuln-triage thread. Do not include internal triage notes in DSAR export. If the customer needs status, provide a sanitized public-facing summary.
dsar-bot: Evidence snapshot created: evidence://dsar/2024/599/initial-inventory (immutable).
omar_kms: Reminder: if we must re-encrypt or rotate keys, perform on a copy and verify decryption before deleting old ciphertext. If any key is scheduled for retirement, postpone until DSAR closed.
lia_legal: I'll contact counsel now. Will update DSAR-2024-599 with their response and whether legal hold is requested.
matt_prod: Thanks. Everyone drop action item updates in `#evidence-dsar-599`. Reopen thread if anything blocks. :lock:
